text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  codex-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run verification script
      run: bun run skills:verify

    - name: Check AGENTS.md for Next.js version consistency
      run: |
        grep -q "next@16.2.1" AGENTS.md || echo "Next.js version in AGENTS.md is inconsistent"

    - name: Notify code owner
      if: failure()
      id: notify_code_owner
      uses: peter-evans/codeowners-action@v1
      with:
        comment: |
          The pull request failed verification checks. Please review the issues and address them before merging.
        labels: |
          needs-revision
```
